what: A Polivoks-style synthesizer for the M-VAVE FM-1, with a 64-step sequencer, DRUM STEP, PAD REC, ONPLAY on K3, 12-pattern drum packs, live transpose, and a drum pattern saved across power cycles. Tested on real hardware by Hans Volt.
author: Hans Volt
sounds: own: boot voice pending replacement with Hans Volt's own self-recorded version

smk37.what: Polivoks on the SMK-37 Elite — 37 velocity keys, 16 RGB pads, 8 encoders, 4 faders, two wheels. Same engine as the FM-1 build: 64-step sequencer, DRUM STEP, PAD REC, ONPLAY on K7. Branded Polivokz to avoid the Formanta trademark. Tested on real hardware by Hans Volt.
